scripts.format: prettier --write frontend && python -m ruff format backend
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend && python -m ruff format --check backend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && python -m ruff check backend && python -m ruff format --check backend
scripts.fix: npm --prefix frontend run lint -- --fix && python -m ruff check --fix backend && npm run format
scripts.check:front: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check
scripts.check:back: python -m ruff check backend && python -m ruff format --check backend
scripts.fix:front: npm --prefix frontend run lint -- --fix && npm run format:front
